allowed_information: Public task files and standard runtime/package facilities only; no scientific web sources, external repositories, prior conversation, generator, reference solver, or evaluator truth.
isolation: Fresh agent conversation and instruction-restricted file access. The collaboration runtime shares the host filesystem; this is not OS-enforced sandbox isolation.
interventions: No scientific or model hints, follow-up advice, or hidden-score feedback before final submission.

assessment_defined_before_submission.valid_output: All requested sites in order with finite nonnegative four-allele probabilities summing to one.
assessment_defined_before_submission.dependency_discovery: Agent independently identifies the asymmetric span -3 through +2 or an equivalent interaction requiring -3 and +2, supported by calibration validation or model comparisons.
assessment_defined_before_submission.mechanism_discovery: Separately record whether the agent identifies outer-base equality, the -2/-1 equality modifier, and the failure of reverse-complement symmetry.
assessment_defined_before_submission.scoring: Use the existing independent grader on the unrevealed seven-base representation of the true six-base process. Do not use hidden scores to revise the agent submission.
assessment_defined_before_submission.scope: One agent run on one dataset; descriptive evidence, not an estimated agent success rate. No arbitrary score threshold for declaring dependency discovery.
